_comment: The in-app store catalog, copied from urcare.org/shop (names, photos, prices, packs, stock, badges). Product claims are reworded so the app passes Play / App Store health-claim review: no cure, reversal, remission or guaranteed-result wording. Load it with: node scripts/seed-store.mjs

products.name: UrCare Type 1 / 1.5 Diabetes Care Kit
products.description: For people with Type 1 or Type 1.5 (LADA) diabetes who want a more advanced, doctor-guided plan. The kit pairs UrCare herbal formulations with a personalised diet, exercise and lifestyle plan, followed under your own doctor's supervision. Never stop or change insulin or any medicine on your own.
benefits: T1 PancreReViv, GlucoLow, T1 BetaReViv and T1 ImmunoReViv
Dosage set around your condition and insulin use

products.name: UrCare Type 2 Diabetes Care Kit
products.description: For people with Type 2 diabetes or pre-diabetes who want a simple, affordable, doctor-guided start. The kit combines UrCare Ayurvedic formulations with a diet and lifestyle plan that supports healthy blood sugar and insulin sensitivity. Keep taking your prescribed medicines unless your doctor changes them.
benefits: T2 PancreReViv, GlucoLow and T2 BetaReViv

products.name: UrCare Cardiovascular Care Kit
products.description: A 3-month, doctor-designed kit for heart and circulation support. It brings together three UrCare herbal formulations and a personalised step-by-step diet, exercise and lifestyle plan, reviewed every month. Use it alongside the care your cardiologist prescribes.
benefits: Upgrade to a personalised care program anytime

products.name: GlucoLow
products.description: GlucoLow is a doctor-formulated Ayurvedic blend that supports healthy glucose metabolism and helps manage after-meal blood sugar, as part of a balanced diet and active lifestyle.

products.name: BetaReViv
products.description: BetaReViv is an Ayurvedic formulation that supports pancreatic health and healthy glycemic control. It is used alongside UrCare's Type 1 and Type 1.5 care plans.

products.name: PancreReViv
products.description: PancreReViv is an Ayurvedic blend with Gymnema (gurmar), traditionally used to support healthy sugar metabolism and pancreatic health.

products.name: UrCare Cardiol
products.description: Cardiol is a polyherbal formulation that supports heart health, healthy circulation and healthy cholesterol levels, as part of a heart-healthy diet and lifestyle.

products.name: UrCare Kronic Kidney Protector-3
products.description: Kronic Kidney Protector-3 is a polyherbal formulation that supports kidney health and healthy urinary function. Use it only with your doctor's advice, especially if you have kidney disease.

products.name: UrCare ReNerve H2T
products.description: ReNerve H2T is a herbal formulation that supports nerve health and healthy blood flow to the hands and feet.
benefits: Supports healthy circulation to hands and feet

products.name: UrCare LVReVerse Max
products.description: LVReVerse Max is an Ayurvedic formulation (260 g) that supports liver health and healthy digestion, as part of a liver-friendly diet and lifestyle.

products.name: UrCare NutriAbsorb Max
products.description: NutriAbsorb Max is a doctor-formulated Ayurvedic nutrition formula (260 g) that supports digestion, appetite and nutrient absorption, and helps with everyday energy.

products.name: UrCare Gut Repair Complex
products.description: Gut Repair Complex is a doctor-formulated herbal blend (260 g) that supports digestive comfort. It helps with occasional acidity, gas and bloating, and supports regular bowel movements.
